     return false;\n437\t    }\n438\t  }\n439\t  return true;\n440\t}\n441\t\n442\t/**\n443\t * Clear a bit in the bitmap (for E12 block hash failure).\n444\t */\n445\texport function ==============================================================================\n461\t// BLOCK POSITION TRACKING FOR WRITES\n462\t// ==============================================================================\n463\t\n464\t/**\n465\t * Concrete implementation of WritePositionTracker.\n466\t *\n467\t * Manages block position  */\n489\t  get currentPosition(): number {\n490\t    return this._currentPosition;\n491\t  }\n492\t\n493\t  /**\n494\t   * Total number of blocks written so far.\n495\t   */\n496\t  get ==============================================================================\n759\t// RESUME TOKEN (D22)\n760\t// ==============================================================================\n761\t\n762\t/**\n763\t * Resume token for persisting session state.\n764\t */\n765\texport interface ResumeToken '../frame/beacon.js';\n796\t\n797\texport function createResumeToken(state: RecvSessionState): ResumeToken | null {\n798\t  if (!canResumeRecv(state)) {\n799\t    return null;\n800\t  }\n801\t\n802\t  message: string,\n91\t    public context: {\n92\t      offset?: number;\n93\t      bytesAttempted?: number;\n94\t      cause?: Error;\n95\t    }\n96\t  ) {\n97\t    super(message);\n98\t    this.name
